findings.title: Empty-line reading recorded as approved
findings.detail: The condition `visibleGroups.length === 0 && (query.length > 0 || !searchPlaceholder)` keeps 'No filter options match that search.' in the eleven popovers without a search. The approval reads 'FacetFilter shows that line only once a query has been typed'. report.md flags the narrower reading 'For review', but TODO row 20 says 'Fixed as Reddy approved on 03/10/2026: … A popover without a search, where nothing can be typed, still says it', which records the reading as part of his approval.
findings.action: Reddy confirms the reading, or the `|| !searchPlaceholder` term goes. Until he does, reword row 20 so his approval and the coder's reading are kept apart.

findings.title: Four new tests never ran red
findings.detail: 'Enter on a matching village…' and 'once the matches are away, the next Escape…' guard behaviour that was already right. 'in High Contrast the Filter's own search keeps one 3px ring…' and 'the top bar's search draws its ring…' cover iteration-1 CSS written before them. Read against the CSS, each of the last two would fail without its rule, but neither has a recorded red run. red-runs.md discloses all four.
findings.action: If a red record is wanted, run the High Contrast Filter-row and top-bar tests with their rules removed, as was done for the late-refusal test, and record it in red-runs.md.

findings.title: Choice paths without a test
findings.detail: A key press in the box clears findTapped, so tapping the field and then pressing Enter on a row is meant to bring focus back, but no test covers that. A mouse choice is tested only in Chromium ('choosing a matching village…' has no @phone tag); WebKit runs only the Enter and tap tests.
findings.action: Add a @phone-only test: tap the field, press Enter on a row, expect the field focused. Tag or copy the mouse-choice test so WebKit runs it too.
